Post build list or current specs including MONITOR: https://pcpartpicker.com/
Provide specific use cases
State BUDGET and COUNTRY or you will NOT be helped

>CASE
mATX: AP201, Lian Li A3/B4, XT M3
ATX: XT PRO (ULTRA), Lancool 207/217, Flux Pro, 4000D FRAME, X50, BF360 Flow, HAF II 500, Summit, Warthog RS
Dual Chamber: Y60/70, O11 Vision, Antec C8

>CPU
Budget: 5600/X, 12400F
Entry level DDR5: 7500F, 7/9600/X, 225F
Gaming: 9850X3D, 9/7800X3D, 250K, 5800X3D
Workstation: 9950X/3D(2), 9900X/3D, 270K

>COOLER
AIO: Thermalright Frozen Edge, Cooler Master Atmos, Lian Li GA II Lite, Nautilus RS, Silent Loop 3, NL-LC1
Dual tower: A620 PRO SE, Phantom Spirit, NH-D15 G2
ITX/>42mm RAM: Big Shuriken 4, Mugen 6 Dual Fan

TIM: Duronaut, MX-7, PTM7950* (phase change), KryoSheet (graphene pad)
*Be wary of counterfeits

>MOTHERBOARD
Avoid ASRock AM5 boards, CPU degradation issues still reported
Choose boards with ALC1220 audio codec when possible

>RAM
Crucial RAM & SSD warranty offers refunds only, no replacements
DDR5: 2x16GB or 2x24GB, 6000CL30 (AMD), 6400CL32 (Intel)
Workstation: 2x 32GB (budget), 2x48GB or 2x64GB (high-end)
DDR4: 3200CL16, 3600CL18

>SSD (update firmware)
DRAMless: (SN)7100, C925G, NM790
PCIe Gen 4.0: (SN)850X
Gen 5.0: (SN)8100

>GPU
Buy the best one you're willing to pay for
Avoid poor value entry-level GPUs

>PSU
Buying guide:
https://hwbusters.com/best_picks/best-atxv3-pcie5-ready-psus-picks-hardware-busters/

>MONITOR
Check reviews & owner feedback
Budget: 165/180Hz IPS (24" 1080p / 27" 1440p)
HDR: discounted OLED or MiniLED (IPS/VA: motion clarity vs. contrast)
High-end: wait for brighter 2027 OLEDs /w stripe RGB subpixels

>CASE FANS

FAQ:
>How do I activate Windows?
HWID2 generates and registers a permanent legitimate license on MS's activation servers
github.com/massgravel/Microsoft-Activation-Scripts
Usage: paste this into Powershell, run.

irm https://get.activated.win | iex



>and Office?
Same link, select Ohook option
You can also use Office.com if your needs are very minimal
or try OnlyOffice/LibreOffice and set it to save in MSOffice file formats

>What version should I install?
>W10 Enterprise IoT LTSC 2021
Binary identical to Enterprise except no MS Store or apps
Preinstalled with: Edge & Win32 system apps
"IoT LTSC" supported until 2032, "LTSC" until 2027

>W11 Enterprise IoT LTSC 2024
Same as W10 version except:
UI written in React Native aka JavaScript including: Start, Taskbar, Explorer
Use only if you fell for the 12th+ gen Intel meme and need the new CPU scheduler

>W11 Enterprise IoT LTSC 2027
Same as 2024 version except:
UI being rewritten in native WinUI
ETA: 2027H2

>Installing apps on LTSC
Use WinGet/Scoop or install MS Store in CMD with: wsreset -i

>W11 Home/Pro/Education/Enterprise/Enterprise IoT
Preinstalled with: Edge, Win32 system apps, MS Store, Candy Crush, etc
Auto-reinstalls apps on feature updates
1.5-3 years support
Forced version upgrades

item.title: [ 34] Officials point to router failure as cause for ATC crash
item.description:
>Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Saturday that a faulty router might have caused the communications outage that prompted the Federal Aviation Administration to issue a nationwide ground stop Friday, disrupting thousands of flights and stranding travelers.
>
>Investigators have not yet determined the exact cause of the router failure, including whether it stemmed from human error, an installation mistake or a problem with the equipment itself.
>
>"At least one of our remote FAA locations, a contractor was doing routine maintenance to switch telecommunication lines from old copper wire, and they were bringing it over to fiber," Duffy said. "What we're working to determine was whether we had incompetence, meaning was it user error or installer error from L3 Harris, or did they install a faulty router."
>
>During the upgrade, Duffy said, a router began flooding the FAA network with traffic, generating more than 1,000 connection attempts every four to five seconds.

item.title: [ 66] Breaking News: FAA Orders Nationwide Ground Stop for All Airports
item.description:
Thread theme: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLHCm7e0uBg

> https://abcnews.com/US/nationwide-ground-stop-ordered-airports-faa/story?id=138121848

The Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop Friday for all airports due to a communication issue affecting air traffic control.

The agency's alert said the stop was "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety."

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in an X statement a short while later that the stop was "due a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers."

"FAA technicians are investigating the issue," he said in an X post.

This is the second time since Sept. 11, 2001, that the FAA has ordered a nationwide ground stop. The last time was in 2023, when the FAA NOTAM system went down and pilots could not get their pre-departure paperwork.

Air Route Traffic Control Centers are responsible for all flights above 18,000 feet. There are 22 of those centers in the U.S.

Pilots who are in the air have flight plans and are prepared to continue with their flight path in case of such an emergency, according to ABC News contributor John Nance.

"All pilots in that environment know what to do," Nance told ABC News on Friday.

"It is a matter of predictability. Air Traffic Control knows that airplane is going to come out of the sky at some point of time looking for a pathway," he later added.

Earlier in the afternoon, the FAA issued a ground stop at both Chicago's O'Hare and Midway airports due to equipment outage.

>This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.

item.title: [ 41] ‘Bring Back THE Boss’: Nvidia Employees Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return
item.description:
https://www.wired.com/story/nvidia-employees-petition-for-jensen-huangs-return/

Some Nvidia employees are calling for Jensen Huang’s return even after his multiple reported extramarital affairs and abrupt resignation, according to internal correspondence reviewed by WIRED.

An internal “suggestion box” post submitted before Huang’s resignation by a longtime engineer at Nvidia urged the company’s board to take employee sentiment into consideration prior to taking any action. The submission has attracted more than 1,600 comments since then, with several asking board members to find a way to bring back Huang.

“If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss,” wrote one anonymous commenter.

“We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance,” wrote another.

One employee went as far as sending a companywide email demanding transparency into Huang’s exit. “I stand by Jensen,” the staffer wrote. “Not because I believe any person is infallible, but because I refuse to believe that standing for fairness must mean standing at a distance from someone whose leadership has meant so much to us.”

The employee couldn’t be reached for comment, while the engineer behind the suggestion box post declined to comment.

Nvidia and its new board chair, investor Harvey Jones, didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: [ 30] BLUNAMI RAGES ON in massive upset as Democrat wins in fringe right wing Mississippi
item.description:
Scott Colom triumphs in one of the most racist and rigged states controlled by conservatives in the United States

https://apnews.com/article/scott-colom-mississippi-senate-midterms-56c18f292a734443992f9466c3b0f346

JACKSON, Miss. (AP) — Democratic nominee Scott Colom defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith on Wednesday in Mississippi’s closely contested U.S. Senate race after a prolonged ballot counting process, giving the state its first Black U.S. senator since post-Civil War Reconstruction.

Colom’s narrow victory is a seismic shift in Mississippi, which has been controlled mostly by white conservatives for generations despite having the largest share of Black residents of any U.S. state. The outcome adds to a decisive midterm rebuke of President Donald Trump, whose party suffered defeats in several Republican-controlled states, and it will bolster some Democrats’ argument that their future runs through the American South.

The Associated Press called the contest Wednesday in Colom’s favor after local elections officials spent several days processing absentee and provisional ballots, called affidavit ballots in Mississippi.

“While this is not the outcome we worked for or hoped for, I respect the decision of Mississippi voters,” Hyde-Smith, 67, said in a two-minute concession speech posted online. “I want to congratulate Scott Colom and wish him well as he takes on the tremendous responsibility of representing our great state.”

A spokesman for the senator said she called Colom to congratulate him and concede before the video was shared publicly.

Colom scheduled a victory celebration with supporters Wednesday night in Jackson.

Colom, a 43-year-old local prosecutor, capitalized on the large Black population, discontent with the economy and Hyde-Smith’s missteps as she sought a second full term.

If you have been to Peru before i would love to hear what you have to say. Recommendations, tips, destinations.

Also if you are in lima the first two weeks of october let me know and maybe we can meet.

item.title: [213] Real Traveler's map™ thread
item.description:
Post your travel maps in this thread. Pic related is the official /trv/ Real Traveler's map™, edition 4.0.5. I am remaking this general after almost a year of it being dead, so this is not the usual OP.

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can use the map however you like, the colors are more like suggestions, you don't have to use them, and you don't have to use all of them. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. Despite what some might say, there's no "wrong" way to use the map, and new posters and less travelled people are welcome and encouraged to stay and post :) This map is a group effort by our board, and we can only improve it if people reach out to share suggestions or corrections.

This is the newest edition of the map, edition 4.0.5, updated for September 2025. Thanks to an Anon in previous threads, it is now easier than ever to fill in the map. You can use the website splored.com to easily color in entire countries with a single click. At the time of making this thread, it uses the old 4.0.4 template, so you still need to update it to 4.0.5 with the simplified template, but hopefully it will be updated.
